description: Figure summarising the whole-proteome Vam10p scans against their shuffled-query nulls, plus a final poll of the fungal blastp job
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, requests

# Values computed in the four preceding cells (seeded ungapped scan, word size 3,
# shuffled-query null; 10 shuffles for the fungal panel, 6 for human and Arabidopsis).
R=[("S. cerevisiae\n(positive control)",6067, 100.0,22.5,0.70,23.7,110.50),
   ("Y. lipolytica",                     6454,  24.6,22.2,0.96,23.7,  2.45),
   ("H. sapiens",                       20414,  23.7,22.5,1.40,24.6,  0.83),
   ("A. thaliana",                      16217,  22.8,22.1,0.94,23.7,  0.78),
   ("C. albicans",                       6028,  21.9,22.4,0.90,23.7, -0.49),
   ("S. pombe",                          5130,  21.9,22.9,0.92,24.6, -1.05),
   ("N. crassa",                        10255,  21.1,21.5,0.90,22.8, -0.49)]
lab=[r[0] for r in R]; obs=np.array([r[2] for r in R]); mu=np.array([r[3] for r in R])
sd=np.array([r[4] for r in R]); nmax=np.array([r[5] for r in R])

fig,(ax1,ax2)=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.6),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1,1.25]})

y=np.arange(len(R))[::-1]
c=["#ddaa33"]+["#4477aa"]*(len(R)-1)
ax1.barh(y,obs,color=c,edgecolor="black",lw=0.6,height=0.65)
ax1.errorbar(mu,y,xerr=2*sd,fmt="o",color="black",ms=4,lw=1.2,capsize=3)
ax1.set_yticks(y); ax1.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=9)
ax1.set_xlabel("best ungapped identity to Vam10p (%)")
ax1.set_title("Whole-proteome scan, seeded at word size 3",fontsize=10.5)
ax1.set_xlim(0,108)
for s in ["top","right"]: ax1.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# zoom on the non-control species, with the null band drawn explicitly
y2=np.arange(len(R)-1)[::-1]
ax2.barh(y2,obs[1:],color="#4477aa",edgecolor="black",lw=0.6,height=0.6)
for yy,m,s_,nm in zip(y2,mu[1:],sd[1:],nmax[1:]):
    ax2.plot([m-2*s_,m+2*s_],[yy,yy],color="black",lw=1.4)
    ax2.plot([m],[yy],"o",color="black",ms=4)
    ax2.plot([nm,nm],[yy-0.33,yy+0.33],color="#aa3333",lw=1.6)
ax2.set_yticks(y2); ax2.set_yticklabels(lab[1:],fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlim(18,27)
ax2.set_xlabel("best ungapped identity to Vam10p (%)")
ax2.set_title("No species exceeds the best score a shuffled Vam10p reaches",fontsize=10.5)
ax2.legend(handles=[plt.Line2D([],[],marker="o",color="black",lw=1.4,label="shuffled-query null, mean $\\pm$ 2 SD"),
                    plt.Line2D([],[],color="#aa3333",lw=1.6,label="best score reached by any shuffled query")],
           fontsize=8.5,loc="lower right")
for s in ["top","right"]: ax2.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("final poll of the fresh fungal blastp job (RID GA1B1E82014):")
try:
    r=requests.get("https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Blast.cgi",
        params={"CMD":"Get","FORMAT_OBJECT":"SearchInfo","RID":"GA1B1E82014"},timeout=50)
    print("  ",[l.strip() for l in r.text.splitlines() if "Status=" in l or "ThereAreHits=" in l])
except Exception as e:
    print("  exception", type(e).__name__)
